newsitem.title: CHINA: China PICC Life pays rare claim to sports star.
newsitem.headline: China PICC Life pays rare claim to sports star.

text.p: The Beijing branch of the People's Insurance Company of China (Life) has paid 10,000 yuan ($1,204) to Olympic gymnast Li Xiaoshuang for an injury sustained during exercise, the Financial News said on Thursday.
The insurer had signed an agreement with the the State Physical Culture and Sports Commission to insure China's Olympic gold, silver and bronze medal winners against injury, it said.
The payment had raised awareness of insurance among China's athletes, who are unfamiliar with insurance, the newspaper quoted Qian Kui, head of China's gymnasts' team, as saying.
